summary.name: B1: r2d amended for the cup-fixed parts

why.USB Port 1 / 9 V gate-drive supply, diod: r2d box (87.8..99.2 x 83.8..91.2) is in Port 2's half and L501 (cup-fixed) covers its lower part; takes the r2d charger-programming box, whose parts go to the U403 pins they serve
why.USB Port 1 / Four-switch power stage. 0R: r2d box kept; west edge 99.3 -> 100.2 for the port border lane
why.USB Port 1 / BQ25756 buck-boost charger:: r2d box widened: it now also holds the charger programming parts, each at the U403 pin it serves
why.USB Port 1 / Charger programming: input: same box as the charger: R409..R419, R435, C410, C411 sit at the U403 pins they serve (r2d had them 15 mm away across the stage)
why.USB Port 2 / 5 V buck for PP5V (TPS62933: r2d box cut at y 88.2: L501 (cup-fixed) and the stage's west capacitor column start there; may spill east into y 83.7..88.2 up to x 90
why.USB Port 2 / Four-switch power stage. 0R: r2d box (78.5..91.4 x 99.9..125.7) does not hold L501, TH501, C521, C556 (cup-fixed at y 88..100); the stage goes where its inductor is, Port 1's stage shifted by -23.03 mm
why.USB Port 2 / BQ25756 buck-boost charger:: r2d box (85.8..98.8 x 91.2..99.9) is under L501; the charger goes below its stage like Port 1's, over the west gap-filler pad
why.USB Port 2 / Charger programming: input: same box as the charger: at the U503 pins they serve
why.3V3 Rail / TPS62177 3.3 V always-on buck: r2d box (91.5..99.7 x 115..123.2) is needed for the protection FETs, which U301 (cup-fixed) pushes west; the buck draws 0.1 A so it goes to the free west area
why.Cells and Gauge / Protection FETs (charg: r2d box (99.7..121.6 x 117.2..124.5) is half under U301 and J301 (fixed); shifted west
why.Cells and Gauge / Second-level protector: r2d box (109.3..121.6 x 124.5..132.7) is under U301 above y 126.7; F102 and Q104 stay at J112, U102 and its filters go beside the gauge or under it on the bottom
why.MCU / CC2340R5MODA module | F.Cu: U301 is cup-fixed at 116.3,122.6 (r2d moved it to 98.6,108.2); its capacitors go in the rim round it
why.MCU / Pull-ups owned by this block | F.C: at the U301 pins they serve (r2d box was beside the r2d module position)
why.MCU / Antenna match (pi network between: at U301 pins 3 and 4 (r2d box was at the bottom edge, 20 mm from the fixed module)
